notes.title: Linelight's 1st Birthday + Free Speed-run Update!
notes.content:
Linelight came out one year ago today. (They grow up so fast.) I purchased a cake for Linelight, but I have been having difficulty feeding Linelight the cake. I am not sure where to put the cake. If anyone has fed Linelight cake before, please let me know how you got Linelight to eat the cake.

I also have a gift for you, dear player: FREE SPEED-RUN UPDATE. (WOOHOO!) If you have been jonesing for a challenge, it is here. I'm actually pretty happy with the update. Time to crack open a can of Linelight!

Happy birthday to Linelight, and I hope you enjoy the new speed-runs! Zorro and I will now get back to work on our next game. :)

notes.title: Emergency Patch v1.01.1
notes.content:
If you've found yourself stranded, trapped, or otherwise unable to advance, good news: This update will rescue you!

Changes:
* Fixed bad saving moments in w2 and w4 finales (can't get trapped in those spots anymore)
* Attempting to enter a finale from the Main Menu OR World Select will clear all the data within that finale and start you at the beginning as a failsafe
* Can't world-warp after the end of a finale anymore
* Fixed incorrect star distribution (239/240 and 61/60). Note: if you got all the stars in the game already, there is a patch on the horizon that will correctly award you your "All World 4 Yellow Stars" achievement. :)

Thank you to all the vocal people in the community who brought this to my attention. And keep bringing any other issues to my attention! :D

notes.title: LINELIGHT. IS. HERE.
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27366411/01abcb1aef88a06da6977051520217eff28a3ef7.jpg[/img]
The wait is over. Linelight is now available.

* [b]Launch week 10% discount to $8.99![/b] *

[url=https://youtu.be/3GwjfUFyY6M]Whooop!![/url] Oh, boy. I haven’t been this excited since the day before Linelight was released!

The waves of support from fans has been wonderful and overwhelming, and for that, I would like to thank you. You are the ones who make this possible. My gratitude to everyone who’s helped Linelight go from me to you is beyond words.

I hope you have as much fun playing Linelight as I did creating it.

With indie love,

-Zorro and Brett
